suppress.notes: False positives from NVD CPE ranges that are wider than the advisories. CVE-2026-53914 (GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp) is unsafe deserialization of untrusted Kotlin build-cache metadata. GHSA lists exactly one affected Maven package: org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin < 2.4.20-Beta1. NVD instead encodes a single coarse cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin with versionEndExcluding 2.4.20, so every artifact in the org.jetbrains.kotlin group below 2.4.20 matches, and NVD re-scored it 9.8 CRITICAL (JetBrains, the CNA, scores it 6.7: AV:L/AC:H/PR:H). kotlin-reflect contains no build-cache code. CVE-2020-29582 (GHSA-cqj8-47ch-rvvq) is insecure permissions on temporary files, scoped by both the advisory text and GHSA to kotlin-stdlib <= 1.4.20. NVD widens it to cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin versionEndExcluding 2.1.0. kotlin-reflect 1.6.10 can never be remediated: kotlin-compiler-embeddable (still as of 2.4.20) hard-pins it, so it resolves on kotlinCompilerClasspath, kotlinBuildToolsApiClasspath and kotlinKlibCommonizerClasspath whatever Kotlin version we use. These are build-time only and not published; suppressed indefinitely. Added: 2026-08-24
